answer: Think of Consecrated beekeeper certificate with apiarists association attestation as a toll booth: a certificate the association renews after hive inspections, so the saffron of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The copper is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The anchor is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
